item.title: Tube trains could navigate the Underground using the rules of Quantum Physics
item.description:
📝 So researchers are turning to something far more exotic: quantum accelerometers. The funding supports the next phase of the Rail Quantum Inertial Navigation System (RQINS) roadmap, aimed at developing quantum navigation for the London Underground — and potentially the wider national rail network. Quantum navigation could shrink that uncertainty to centimetres, making it far quicker to pinpoint exactly where a defect lies.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ianvisits.co.uk/articles/tube-trains-could-navigate-the-underground-using-the-weird-rules-of-quantum-physics-86370/
